passwordRule:
Password must be at least 8 characters without white-space and contain at least 3 of the following:

• Uppercase letter [A-Z]
• Lowercase letter [a-z]
• Numeric [0-9]
• Special character (!,@,#,etc..)

For example: 59D7!4$h, 493abcDE
